summary.text: Dan Cruce represents Delaware's 1st Senate District, which includes Bellefonte and parts of Alapocas, Edgemoor and Wilmington.

paragraphs.text: He is from Chesapeake, Virginia, earned a degree in international affairs from James Madison University and a law degree from Delaware Law School.
He served as Deputy Secretary of Education and Chief of Staff in the administration of Governor Jack Markell and later as Education Vice President at Hope Street Group.
Cruce is Chief Operating Officer of United Way of Delaware and lives in Wilmington.
